C.name: Predictive Coding（預測編碼）
C.responsibility: Prediction, observation, prediction-error measurement, uncertainty calibration and evidence-based model updates.

E.name: Deep Research（深度研究）
E.responsibility: Multi-source research, source provenance and quality, corroboration, counter-evidence, cited synthesis and cross-track research support.

policy: Each governed workstream A-H owns an independent numeric MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH version. MAJOR is the human-facing vN generation; major reform increments MAJOR and resets MINOR/PATCH to zero. MINOR is backward-compatible capability; PATCH is every smaller improvement. Every change bumps affected track version(s) and changelog. Cross-track changes list each affected track and compatibility evidence; unaffected tracks are not bumped. F-H must be registered with approved name, owner and scope before activation.
